title: Teriyaki tempeh with broccoli
summary: Teriyaki tempeh with broccoli is a japanese dinner built around tempeh and broccoli, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Pat tempeh dry and season it. Prep broccoli and tamari for Teriyaki tempeh with broccoli so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook tempeh on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook broccoli and tamari in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Teriyaki tempeh with broccoli before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice tempeh and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.
